title: It's freezing out. Sag packed a tent.
caption: Too cold for dates? Winter just needs a plan with a scarf on. A market stroll, a sunrise walk with cocoa, or a night in mapping trips you'd love to take. Send this to someone who keeps saying it's too cold.
